correctness.rationale: For every real delta in [0,1], the necessity operator applied to f with range in {0} union [delta,1] has attained infimum for all f precisely when the strict delta-superlevel of the fixed accessibility row is finite. The proof checks zero input values separately; the converse assigns delta+min((r-delta)/2,1/(k+1)) along infinitely many larger weights, giving an unattained infimum delta. Diamond sufficiency localizes any positive supremum to a finite positive superlevel; necessity chooses infinitely many weights at least epsilon and formula values epsilon*k/(k+1), giving an unattained supremum. Combining thresholds gives the exact identity between unrestricted diamond robustness and box robustness at all positive cutoffs. Finite-input and interval-realization clauses follow from the finite residual range, reverse-well-order criterion, and explicit countable weight sequences. Nonempty W and zero-weight boundaries are handled. One atomic proposition detects every failing all-valuation frame condition. The in-package exact-rational checker passed finite-prefix tests; no finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Inspected recent full-text sources define full/partial witnessed semantics and establish logical completeness but do not characterize accessibility rows uniformly under every valuation. The 2022 paraconsistent bi-Gödel paper gives a different finite-branching-definability theorem and only the sufficient finite-branching observation for witnesses; it neither provides the c0 versus finite-support separation nor the sharp delta-superlevel spectrum. The closest recorded published-finding corpus finite Gödel regrading result concerns fixed finite labelled worlds where attainment is automatic. Actual synonym, implication and parameter searches found no logically covering theorem; this absence is not taken as uniqueness proof. Older max-min fuzzy relation theory remains a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: Older fuzzy-relational max-min/inf-residuum operator theory may formulate the scalar all-input attainment property under different terminology, without discussing Gödel modal frames.
Existing fuzzy description-logic witnessed-interpretation literature might contain implicit row-finiteness results not surfaced in targeted searches.
Claims about all scalar inputs are direct mathematical implications from the Gödel residuum and should not be mistaken for a new axiomatization or new logic-validity theorem.

value.rationale: The exact distinction between fuzzy frame classes guaranteeing every valuation is diamond-witnessed or fully box/diamond-witnessed directly addresses a recognized semantic obstruction to completeness/finite-model reasoning. The strict inclusion is witnessed by natural decaying infinite accessibility rows. The parameterized theorem gives a natural complete filtration by minimum positive truth degree with every possible upper interval realized; it quantifies precisely how finite-precision restrictions change guaranteed witnesses. The binary/finite-palette criterion supplies a different reverse-well-order boundary. This is a structural classification of an infinite model family, not a table recomputation or arbitrary slice. It does not require claims of unrelated downstream results.
